purpose: Complete the frozen CF4 x VAST path-geometry source bundle with the exact Planck2018 angular/radial survey mask before any scientific response row is decoded.

geometry_contract.angular_indexing: Use the official VAST mask semantics at resolution 1; endpoint and every quadrature point must be inside the true RA/Dec pixel and frozen radial limits.
geometry_contract.coordinate_units: VAST Cartesian sphere coordinates are numeric h^-1 Mpc; an independent CF4 distance D_Mpc maps to radial coordinate h*D_Mpc for the frozen H0 cell.
geometry_contract.primary_union: Planck2018 VoidFinder table2 spheres belonging to table1 void IDs with edge=0; exact ray-sphere intervals are unioned, never summed.
geometry_contract.path_scope: Only the portion of the observer-to-group ray inside the official survey mask and radial limits is classified. Unobserved path is not silently labeled matter.
remaining_before_decode: freeze H0/effect/nuisance/error grids and eligibility counts
freeze the restricted safe mask decoder and coordinate-consistency probes
freeze mock/RSD revision or label mechanism inference unavailable
